overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the May 21 notice topic "Discuss Director of Operations Role" was sufficiently specific, and the Board did not have to list a possible reconsideration or rescission vote.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the May 21 meeting notice was not specific enough because it omitted votes to reconsider and rescind the April 9 vote creating a Director of Operations position.
allegations.key_passage: We are satisfied that the topic as listed on the notice of the May 21 meeting was sufficient to reasonably advise the public of the issue to be discussed at the meeting, and that a vote or votes might follow.
